title: Combined Records
subtitle: Every purchase in one place: request → quotations → PO → delivery → invoice → payment.
searchPlaceholder: Search any number (PO60, Q12, MPR7, invoice), vendor or material
none: No purchases yet. Start with "New request".

nextHelp.submitRequest: This request is a draft. Submit it for approval.
nextHelp.approveRequest: The request is waiting for the Project Head / Head of Construction and an admin to approve it. When it is approved, its first quotation is created automatically.
nextHelp.addQuotation: Add the quotations you received for this request, then finalize one.
nextHelp.finalizeQuotation: Compare the quotations and finalize one (Project Head, Head of Construction, Admin 1, Admin 2 or super admin). The PO is then created automatically.
nextHelp.enterPoAmount: The PO has no amount yet. Enter the item prices; the amount is the only thing that stops an approval.
nextHelp.approvePo: The PO is waiting for approval. The budget head and payment type can be set any time and never need approval.
nextHelp.receiveGoods: The PO is approved. Record the delivery in Goods Receipts.
nextHelp.addInvoice: Add the vendor's invoice for this PO.
nextHelp.makePayment: Pay the vendor (or reimburse the person who paid at site).
nextHelp.completed: Everything is done: delivered, invoiced and paid.

noRequest: This purchase has no material request.
siteBillsNoRequest: Site bills: each bill is its own request with no approval of its own.
nonVendorNoQuotation: One-time vendor: no quotation is needed, the PO is created straight after approval.
quotationsAfterApproval: Quotations come after the request is approved.
compareHint: Compare the quotations and finalize the one to buy from. Each material can be finalized once; different materials can come from different vendors.
poAfterApproval: The PO is created automatically when the request is approved.
poAfterFinalize: The PO is created automatically when a quotation is finalized.
siteBillsNoDelivery: Bought at site: no delivery step.
siteBillsNoInvoice: The bills are the invoices: no separate invoice.
noFinancialAccess: Quotations, POs and payments are shown only to users who can see financials.
amountMissing: No amount on this PO yet. Enter the prices; it cannot be approved at ₹0.
budgetHeadMissingHelp: Not set yet. Set it any time; no approval needed.
finalizedWithPo: Quotation finalized. Purchase Order {{po}} was created and sent for approval.
requestApproved: Request approved. Its first quotation was created; finalize a quotation to create the PO.
addQuotationHint: Pick the vendor and enter its rates. Untick materials this vendor did not quote for.
ratesNeededToFinalize: Enter the rates before this quotation can be finalized.
vendorDetailsLater: Bank, GST and other details can be added later in Vendors.
vendorFlow: After approval, the first quotation is created from this vendor and your estimated rates. You can add quotations from other vendors and finalize one.
nonVendorFlow: One-time vendor: after approval the PO is created directly, without a quotation.
estRateHint: Estimated rates are optional; they become the first quotation's rates and can be changed before finalizing.
reviewHint: Save as a draft to finish later, or submit it for approval now.
